note: 23 PDF sheets of 595x842 whose running header prints "Page N Control # 43443", so printed page = PDF page - 1: PDF 1 is the unnumbered official summary sheet (the "Team Control Number 43443 / Problem Chosen E" stub block, page furniture with no art, and the layout pass measured nothing there, so it needs no exclusion), PDF 2 is the title page, and references open on PDF 21 (printed 20) and run to PDF 23. Six measured regions on three pages - 7, 14 and 20 - and every one is an exhibit, so 5 figure rows and 1 table row with nothing excluded and nothing unaccounted; the file embeds no raster image at all, and outside those three pages the drawing list holds nothing but the summary sheet's full-page background rectangle and short rule lines, which is why the figure census is this short for a 22-page paper. Numbering is thin: only 4 numbers are ever printed, all as "Figure N:", so 4 of the 6 exhibits carry a caption and the two on p7 - the ten-country WSI/EWR grid and the scatterplot under it - have neither number nor caption and record none/none. All four captions sit below the art and all four charts are single-panel, so no row is captionless-but-shared. The four figures are two designed pairs: Figures 1 and 2 plot two bound curves each and differ only by a 2018-2022 kink, and Figures 3 and 4 plot four curves each under the identical in-art title "Estimated Water Ratio Per Year", Figure 3 being the infrastructure case whose with/without gap never exceeds about 20 units. Citation is thin too: Figures 1 and 2 share one parenthetical on p13, Figure 3 is cited on p19 and Figure 4 on p21 (the only citation that follows its figure rather than preceding it, lead_pages -1), the scatterplot gets the paper's only deictic pointer ("The scatterplot below"), and the country grid is pointed at by nothing, though the prose quotes two of its cells (China 0.478, USA 0.499). The Section 6 heading wraps after "for" and was missed by the heading detector, so the p20 pair records its printed first line as the section path.
rules: 编号只按纸面记录，缺失不外推：正文与图注只见 4 个 Figure 编号（1 至 4），p7 上那张十国表与紧随其后的散点图既无编号也无图题，两者都记 numbering=none、caption_source=none，verbatim 留空。[caption.numbering]
p7 的表格是整格描边的 ruled grid：外框与两条列分隔线加上逐行横线全部画出，因此 rule_style=boxed，表头行自成一格，EWR 列表头里带单位写法 "(gal / person / year)"，故 units_in_header=true。[table.rule_style]
图注位置一律在图下方：4 条带题注的图行都是先图后题（position=below），两张无题注的 p7 行按全篇惯例同样记 below，因为纸面上方也没有任何题注。[caption.position]
引用记数不合并：Figure 1 与 Figure 2 共用 p13 的同一句括号引用 "(Figure 1) ... (Figure 2)"，但两行各自记 count=1、style 各取其一；Figure 3 引于 p19，Figure 4 引于 p21。[mention.count]
引用页与图形页的先后必须照实记：前三处引用都出现在图形前一页（lead_pages=1），只有 Figure 4 的引用落在 p21、其图在 p20，故 lead_pages=-1。[mention.first_page]
散点图只有指示性指代而无编号：正文写 "The scatterplot below"，故记 first_page=7、style=[]、count=0、pattern=direct，与同页那张完全没有指代的表格区分开。[mention.style]
章节路径照纸面取：第 6 节标题印作 "6 Projection of Future Water Availability for India" 但在 "for" 后换行，标题抽取漏检，place.section_path 因此记印刷首行，而不是自拟一个不存在的标题。[place.section_path]
